title: Open Dataset of Nepal Statutory Financial Slabs, Customary Land Measurement Units (Ropani/Bigha), and Utility Tariffs (2082/83–2083/84 BS)
description: Structured reference datasets for Nepal's statutory income tax brackets (IRD), customary land measurement conversions (Ropani-Aana-Paisa-Daam & Bigha-Kattha-Dhur), and utility rates. Canonical interactive calculators and live verification tools are hosted at https://nepalicalc.com.
